ruleDefinitions.name: Security Service Disabled Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" to disable security services such as Windows Defender.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*reg.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*d\\ 4.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*v\\ Start.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppIDSvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsMpSvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\NisSrv.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SecurityHealthService.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Sense.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\UsoSvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WdBoot.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WdFilter.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WdNisDrv.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WdNisSvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WinDefend.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\wscsvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\wuauserv.*"))))
